body: Hello, my appeal was accepted but I am still banned.  The topic is here https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/609c21f74 .  It has been 2 days since I was accepted, and this has really been an inconvenience.  Please see this forum quickly so that I do not have to spend anymore time banned.  Thanks for taking your time and volunteering to be a staff member.
